name: workflow-backend
description: Backend API for Workflow Repository Management System

scripts.test: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const { execSync } = require('child_process'); function findTests(dir) { let results = []; for (const file of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) { const full = dir + '/' + file.name; if (file.isDirectory()) results = results.concat(findTests(full)); else if (file.name.endsWith('.test.ts')) results.push(full); } return results; } for (const test of findTests('src')) { console.log('Testing: ' + test); execSync('npx ts-node ' + test, { stdio: 'inherit' }); }"
